description: Implementation of NoteService interface providing CRUD operations for notes, including methods to create, retrieve, update, and delete notes with owner-based filtering.

classes.name: NoteServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of NoteService providing transactional CRUD operations for notes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified owner ID and request data.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by ID, filtered by owner ID if provided.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes, either all or filtered by owner ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note's title and content based on provided request data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID if it exists.
